NRLW Stars Elliott and Baxter Announce Retirements

Millie Elliott and Corban Baxter, described as influential figures in the NRLW, have announced their retirements from the sport. The Sydney Roosters players will conclude their careers at the end of the current finals series. Their retirements mark the departure of two prominent athletes from the league.
